section.heading: Public litter container replacement.
section.text: As part of the completion in Fiscal Year 2027 of a newly renovated or modernized District of Columbia Public Schools facility or Department of Parks and Recreation-managed property ("project property"), the Department shall procure publicly accessible and secure rodent-resistant trash and recycling containers and install the containers on the site of, and in the public space immediately abutting, the lot or square of the project property.
